raw_tokens.value: Warpriest Bonus Feat ~ Net and Trident
Your skill with lighter weapons allows you to wield one alongside your net.

You can treat a net as a one-handed ranged weapon, allowing you to wield a light or one-handed melee weapon and still make ranged attacks with your net. When you use your light or one-handed melee weapon to attack an entangled opponent, you gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls and on attack rolls to confirm a critical hit. &nl; [Normal] A net is a two-handed ranged weapon.
